references.text: Therefore Levi received no share or inheritance with his brothers. The Lord is his inheritance, as the Lord your God said to him.

The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no share or inheritance with Israel. They shall live from the Lord's fire offerings and his inheritance. They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The Lord is their inheritance, as he said to them.
The Lord said to Aaron: You shall have no inheritance in their land, and you shall have no share among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
But the Levites have no share among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance.
Ezekiel also describes that the Levites' inheritance is the Lord himself, and that they shall have no property in Israel.

The Levites shall serve at the tent of meeting and bear their own guilt. They shall have no inheritance among the children of Israel, for the tithe that the Israelites give to the Lord I have given to the Levites as an inheritance.
